controls.description: List of control configurations. Each item specifies device, control ID, and optional value to write. If ctrl is omitted, all controls (0–255) are queried (-d). If value is omitted, the current value is read (-r). If device is omitted, probes I2C devices (-p). One line per item is generated per documented behavior. When item.device is absent, the line starts with '-p' instead of 'dev:...'. When item.ctrl is absent, '-d' is emitted; otherwise '-r <ctrl>'. When item.value is present, '-w <value>' is added after '-r'. Each item is rendered as a multi-line block (device + ctrl + value options).

verbosity.description: Increase verbosity. Specifying -v once increases verbosity (e.g., -v); 0 means no -v flag. Multiple -v flags are not emitted (per documented 'specify more to increase' — we use single -v for simplicity in production config).

force.description: Force operation without validity checks. Emits -f if true.

database_dir.description: Path to the ddccontrol-db directory. Uses default if omitted, and emits -b only if set to non-default value.
